25. (Original) A kit comprising: reagents suitable for determining an endometrial gene expression profile of a panel of genes, wherein the panel of genes consists of: ANXA4, CATSPERB, PTGFR, PTGS1, IL8, SCGB2A2, ANGPTL1, HPRT1, MMP10, PGR, ITGA8, IFNG, PROK I, FOXOI, CXCL1, STC1, MMP9, MUCI, RPL13A, CALCA, ITGA9, RACGAP1, GPX3, PPP2R2C, ARG2, SCGB3A1, ALDH1A3, APOD, C2CD4B, TFF3, AQP3, GJA4, ARHGDIA, SELL, APOL2, MTIH, MTIX, MTIL, MAOA and MTlF in a biological sample obtained from a subject.
26. (Original) The kit of claim 25, wherein the biological sample is an endometrial biopsy obtained from the uterine fundus.
27. (Original) The kit of claim 25, wherein the reagents are suitable for reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction.
28. (Original) The kit of claim 25, further comprising a chip, an array, a multi-well plate or a tube.
29. (Original) The kit of claim 25, further comprising instructions for use of the kit according to claim 1.
